title: Filing: Chinese chip designer OmniVision Integrated Circuits seeks to raise up to ~$617M in a Hong Kong IPO; HKEX: Hong Kong IPOs have raised ~$36B in 2025 (Sneha Kumar/Reuters)
summary: Sneha Kumar / Reuters: Filing: Chinese chip designer OmniVision Integrated Circuits seeks to raise up to ~$617M in a Hong Kong IPO; HKEX: Hong Kong IPOs have raised ~$36B in 2025 — China's OmniVision Integrated Circuits (603501.SS) aims to raise up to HK$4.80 billion ($616.94 million) in its Hong Kong listing …
